metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need NO₂ tropospheric column data. The S5P/TROPOMI “OFFL” or “NRTI” NO2 collection (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2) is ideal – it provides daily global tropospheric vertical column density. Taiwan is the spatial focus; so we define a polygon around the main island to keep it simple (about 22-25°N, 120-122°E). 2. Masking strategy: Tropospheric NO₂ products already come with qa_value. Using qa_value > 0.75 as recommended filters out cloudy/low-quality retrievals. We will cloud-mask by `gte(75)`. 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero from null/error: - Compute mean NO₂ for Period 1 (Feb 10–25, 2020) and Period 2 (Apr 20–May 12, 2020) over the Taiwan polygon. - Check that each collection `.size()` is > 0 (else C1). - After masking, count valid pixels; if zero, C2. - If computed means are None/NaN (C3), else compare. If mean2 > mean1 => “Yes” (A), else “No” (B). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[120.0, 22.0], [122.0, 22.0], [122.0, 25.4], [120.0, 25.4]], None, False) p1_start, p1_end = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25' p2_start, p2_end = '2020-04-20', '2020-05-12' # 2. Data Acquisition def get_no2_mean(start, end): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(taiwan) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filter(ee.Filter.gte('qa_value', 0.75))) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, n, 0 comp = col.mean().multiply(1e15) # convert mol/m2 to 1e15 molecules/cm2 cnt = comp.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() mean = comp.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() return mean, n, cnt m1, n1, c1 = get_no2_mean(p1_start, p1_end) m2, n2, c2 = get_no2_mean(p2_start, p2_end) # 3. Validation & Answer print(f"Feb Images: {n1}, Pixels: {int(c1)}, Mean: {m1:.2f}") print(f"Apr-May Images: {n2}, Pixels: {int(c2)}, Mean: {m2:.2f}") if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0: print("C1") elif c1 == 0 or c2 == 0: print("C2") elif m1 is None or m2 is None: print("C3") elif m2 > m1: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[120.0, 22.0], [122.0, 22.0], [122.0, 25.4], [120.0, 25.4]], None, False)
p1_start, p1_end = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25'
p2_start, p2_end = '2020-04-20', '2020-05-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition
def get_no2_mean(start, end):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFLINE/L3_NO2')
           .filterDate(start, end)
           .filterBounds(taiwan)
           .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
           .filter(ee.Filter.gte('qa_value', 0.75)))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None, n, 0
    comp = col.mean().multiply(1e15)  # convert mol/m2 to 1e15 molecules/cm2
    cnt = comp.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    mean = comp.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    return mean, n, cnt

m1, n1, c1 = get_no2_mean(p1_start, p1_end)
m2, n2, c2 = get_no2_mean(p2_start, p2_end)

# 3. Validation & Answer
print(f"Feb Images: {n1}, Pixels: {int(c1)}, Mean: {m1:.2f}")
print(f"Apr-May Images: {n2}, Pixels: {int(c2)}, Mean: {m2:.2f}")

if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif c1 == 0 or c2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif m1 is None or m2 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif m2 > m1:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
